icl_english.text: The morning train was late again, so we walked along the river and talked about the summer.
icl_english.reference_text: Brion saw something close to panic on his opponent's face when the man finally recognized his error.

icl_chinese.text: 今天天气很好，我们一起去公园散步，然后在湖边喝杯咖啡。
